name: Ōasa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ōasa town emblem in white: a stylised angular device of two chevrons, like a letter M.
history: Flag of the former town of Ōasa in Hiroshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-02-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 December 1974.

features.role: Ōasa town emblem — a stylised angular device of two chevrons, like a letter M
